title: Remove redundant TT miss guards in search
rationale: Stockfish PR #6835 removes redundant ttHit-dependent reassignments after TT probe. It passed a large non-regression STC (645408 games, LLR 5.07; 164134 W / 164382 L / 316892 D) and is explicitly non-functional. FayE's current TT probe already returns Move::none() and VALUE_NONE on misses, while both main search and qsearch still re-guard those fields, so the core optimization remains directly applicable without changing NNUE features or search semantics.

screen.decision: Advance to confirmation because strength was inconclusive while the non-functional patch showed a reproducible-looking +1.527% median NPS signal.

confirmation.decision: Run one fresh 1200-game paired repeat confirmation rather than merge or reject. The first confirmation is positive (+6.66 Elo, LOS 92.79%) but SPRT did not cross a boundary (LLR 0.27), and the hosted runner cannot safely extend one job much beyond this duration.

promotion_rule: Do not merge from the screen or a single inconclusive confirmation. Evaluate the independent repeat together with the first confirmation; promote only if strength remains non-adverse and the efficiency signal remains credible. Otherwise mark no-promotion and move to another mechanism.
notes: One mechanism only: remove redundant ttHit guards for move/value after probe in main search and qsearch.
FayE TT miss initialization was verified before creating the experiment.
No NNUE architecture, relational feature, or time-management changes.
FAYE-0004 was no-promoted after a flat 400-game screen and 0.000% median NPS delta.
